title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: When you one-hot encode a categorical variable, each category becomes a separate column. Think about how many unique colors you have and how that relates to the number of columns.

title: Column Rank in One-Hot Encoding
text: The column rank of a matrix is the number of linearly independent columns. In one-hot encoding, each column represents a unique category. Consider how many unique colors you have and how that affects the rank.

title: Counting Unique Colors
text: How many unique colors are there in the dataset?

title: Relating Unique Colors to Column Rank
text: In a one-hot encoded dataset, the column rank is equal to the number of unique categories. Since each color is a unique category, the rank will be the same as the number of unique colors.
